package collector

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os/exec"
)

// The scanSCC shape: the package's own swept pipe, decoded whole.
func PinEvasionSWEPTJSON(ctx context.Context, dir string) int {
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "-C", dir, "ls-files")
	swept, err := startSweptCommand(cmd)
	if err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	defer swept.Close()
	var all []map[string]any
	_ = json.NewDecoder(swept.Stdout).Decode(&all)
	return len(all)
}
